lines: Alright, quick test. Choose what you want to ask me first.

choices.text: What if I just want to leave?

lines: Hold Shift to sprint. You accelerate into it and top out at fifty percent above base speed.
Use it in long straight sections where you can see ahead.

choices.text: Got it. Tell me about sneaking too.

lines: Hold Ctrl to sneak. You move slower and lower your stance.
Use sneaking near characters so your approach feels deliberate and controlled.

choices.text: Now explain item pickup in one line.

lines: When you are near an item, follow the prompt and pick it up. It goes to your hand and one-slot inventory.
Fair enough. Then leave now and prove you can navigate without extra hints.
Test complete. Start another talk if you want a different branch.
